subject: Onsite demo — Redwood HQ access & visitor logistics
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@acme.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Requesting Redwood HQ demo and visitor pass info

Hi Soojin & Rachel,

Thanks again for offering an onsite demo for the Acme integration team. We'd like to bring a small group (3 people) to Redwood's Novato HQ on Thursday, Oct 23rd, ideally mid-morning. High level:

- Attendees: Amy Chen (product lead), Dave Lin (integration eng), Priya Kapoor (security)
- Goal: 60–75 minute walkthrough of the Dedicated deployment flow and a short Q&A with SREs

Before we lock travel we need to confirm visitor access, NDA signing, and whether a conference room with AV is available. I attached our visitor form with names and IDs.

Questions:
1) Is the Redwood site visitor form enough, or do we need additional forms?
2) Can you host us in a room with a projector and Zoom bridge (we may bring one laptop)?
3) Any parking or check-in details we should share with the team?

Appreciate a quick confirmation so we can proceed with travel.

Best,
Amy Chen
Product Lead, Acme Robotics
amy@acme.ai
Attachment: Acme_Site_Visitor_Form.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@acme.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting Redwood HQ demo and visitor pass info

Hi Amy — thanks for the note and for attaching the form. Looping in Marissa from facilities and Rachel from ops to lock the room and badge process. Quick answers below; we'll follow up with formal confirmations.

- Visitor paperwork: Acme_Site_Visitor_Form looks good. We do ask guests to sign our standard visitor NDA on arrival unless a mutual NDA is already in place. I've attached our NDA (Redwood_NDA_v3.pdf) — if Priya can sign and return before arrival that speeds check-in.
- AV / room: We have Conference Room C (ground floor) with HDMI, wireless presentation, and a Zoom room system. Capacity 8–10. If you need a projector, we can set that up.
- Parking / check-in: Free visitor parking is in Lot B (follow signs); guests should check in at the lobby kiosk and have a photo ID. If you email the names and IDs by EOD Wednesday (Oct 22), Facilities will pre-print badges to make entry smoother.

Proposed schedule (tentative):
- 10:00 — arrival / badge check-in
- 10:15 — 60–75 min demo in Conf C (SRE + product leads)
- 11:45 — informal wrap / extra Q&A in breakout

Let me know if that works and whether you want lunch options ordered for the group after.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Amy Chen <amy@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2025 08:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting Redwood HQ demo and visitor pass info

On Wed, Oct 14, 2025 at 10:03 AM Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com> wrote:
> - Visitor paperwork: Acme_Site_Visitor_Form looks good...

Confirmed on room & AV: Conference Room C is available Oct 23 at 10:00–12:00. I reserved the Zoom bridge and set the room to use the HDMI input by default. I'll add a calendar event and invite the attendees once Amy confirms final names.

Badge procedure (operational notes):
- Please submit full legal names + government ID numbers (driver's license or passport) to me by 23:59 PDT on Oct 22.
- If you prefer not to send IDs over email, we can accept them at check-in but the pre-printing avoids delays.
- Visitor badges expire at 18:00 and are escorted-only after 17:00.

AV contact on site: Eduardo Ramos (ext. 3427) — I'll cc him on the event invite so he can meet the laptop and ensure the Zoom bridge is clean.

Attachment: None.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Operations Program Manager — Redwood Inference
rachel@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@acme.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Oct 2025 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting Redwood HQ demo and visitor pass info

Hi Amy — quick logistics confirmation from Facilities: 

- We received the Acme_Site_Visitor_Form and pre-printed badges will be waiting at the kiosk. If Priya signs the Redwood NDA ahead of time (Redwood_NDA_v3.pdf), please send it back to me and I'll add it to the visitor packet.
- Meeting room set for 10:00 in Conf C (AV checked at 09:30). Eduardo will meet the group at the room and test the Zoom link.
- Parking: Please direct guests to Lot B gate; leave the QR code window card visible. If any of your team arrives before 10:00, they can wait in the lobby; we'll have a staff escort for the duration of the visit.

One last note on security: Priya mentioned data-handling questions. We can set aside 20 minutes at the end of the session for Priya to speak directly with our security engineer (Tom Baxter is also copied here from PrimeAI partnership side). If you want that added to the calendar event I can extend the room to 12:15.

Safe travels — looking forward to hosting you.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Facilities & Real Estate Lead — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Attachment: Redwood_NDA_v3.pdf (for signature)
